neighbours.label: the name-initial piece ' Lu' in Portuguese and Spanish proper names (Luís, Luiz, Luanda, Luísa)
fire: The ship was commanded by Luís Vaz, a captain from Lisbon.
Her grandfather, Luiz Carlos, ran a bakery in São Paulo.
The flight from Lisbon to Luanda was delayed by a storm.
The painting was donated by Luísa Mendes in 1902.
The coach, Luiz Felipe, praised the young striker.
In 1620 Luís de Sousa sailed for the colony in Brazil.
The oil company moved its offices to Luanda last year.
The poet Luís de Camões wrote the national epic of Portugal.
quiet: The ship was commanded by João Vaz, a captain from Lisbon.
Her grandfather, Pedro Carlos, ran a bakery in São Paulo.
The flight from Lisbon to Maputo was delayed by a storm.
The painting was donated by Maria Mendes in 1902.
The coach, Carlos Alberto, praised the young striker.
In 1620 Martim de Sousa sailed for the colony in Brazil.
The oil company moved its offices to Lagos last year.
The poet Fernando Pessoa wrote many works under other names.

notes: Card: ' Lu' and 'Lu' are 15 of the top 32 peaks, in Luís, Luiz, Luanda, Luisa; also Korean 루이 (Louis).
